category_edits.rationale: Untie the 32-dimensional history and output item embeddings, initializing the output table as an exact independent copy without consuming additional random draws. This may reduce conflicting gradients between history encoding and candidate discrimination. All four datasets retain one jointly trained SASRec model each. The existing predictor writer imports the updated SASRec class and loads its complete state dictionary, including both tables.
